entry.title: 11th Bank of Finland and European Systemic Risk Board Joint Conference on AI and Systemic Risk Analytics
entry.content:
A hybrid conference presenting research that applies AI methods and new data sources to financial stability and systemic risk analysis, alongside traditional tools such as early-warning indicators, network/contagion analysis and macro stress-testing.

  • Type: conference
  • Dates: 3.-4. June 2026
  • Location: Helsinki, Finland
  • Organizer: Bank of Finland and European Systemic Risk Board (ESRB)

entry.title: 1st IEEE Workshop on Networked AI Agents in a Decentralized Architecture (NANDA)
entry.content:
Covers sandboxing, privacy, trust establishment without central control, and rigorous evaluation needed to make internet-scale networks of autonomous, delegating AI agents trustworthy in practice.

  • Type: workshop
  • Dates: November 4–6, 2026
  • Location: San Jose, CA
  • Organizer: Co-located with IEEE TPS 2026; Project NANDA

entry.title: 1st NeurIPS Workshop on Agentic Web (NeurIPS 2026)
entry.content:
Research submissions treat internet-scale networks of communicating, adapting AI agents—rather than single models—as the unit of analysis, spanning representation/discovery, learning dynamics over agent graphs, and coordination, governance and safety at population scale.

  • Type: workshop
  • Dates: Submission deadline September 5, 2026; Workshop December 2026 (exact date TBD)
  • Location: Atlanta, GA
  • Organizer: Co-located with NeurIPS 2026; organized by Project NANDA

entry.title: ADCOM 2027 – Call for Papers
entry.content:
ADCOM 2027 solicits papers on architectures, coordination protocols, infrastructure and security frameworks for distributed, agent-driven computing ecosystems including centralized/decentralized agent networks and the Internet of Agents.

  • Type: cfp
  • Dates: Paper Submission Deadline: 15 October 2026; Notification of Acceptance: 28 February 2027; Camera-Ready Submission: 25 March 2027
  • Organizer: Advanced Computing and Communications Society (ACCS)

entry.title: AI and Multi-scale Human Intelligence
entry.content:
A convening examining how AI reshapes intelligence and institutional accountability at individual, organizational, and societal scales, including new oversight or power-redistribution mechanisms.

  • Type: workshop
  • Organizer: Santa Fe Institute

entry.title: AI for Mechanism Design and Strategic Decision Making (AIMS@ICLR2026)
entry.content:
Covers AI methods for redefining or automating core problems in mechanism design and strategic decision making, including auctions, matching, voting, and equilibrium dynamics in multi-agent systems.

  • Type: workshop
  • Dates: Submission Deadline: 3 February 2026; Workshop Time: 26 April 2026
  • Organizer: Co-located with ICLR 2026 (International Conference on Learning Representations)

entry.title: AI4GOOD @ NeurIPS 2026 — Multi-agent Security and Safety Track
entry.content:
Covers collusion, secure delegation, compositional safety failures, and oversight mechanisms for networks of interacting AI agents deployed at scale.

  • Type: workshop
  • Location: Paris, France
  • Organizer: NeurIPS 2026 workshop; track co-hosted by Klaudia Krawiecka (University of Oxford) and Swapneel Mehta (Vector Institute)

entry.title: AWESOME-2026: First Workshop on Agentic AI Systems, Welfare, Social Mechanisms, and Multi-Agent Ecosystems
entry.content:
How autonomous agents should act within human and institutional norms in multi-agent ecosystems, covering trust, transparency, accountability, and collective intelligence design for societal welfare.

  • Type: workshop
  • Dates: Deadline for Submission: 30 May 2026; Workshop (half-day, tentative): 11 August 2026
  • Location: Bremen, Germany
  • Organizer: Co-located with the 49th German Conference on Artificial Intelligence (KI 2026); organized by Johannes Fähndrich (Hochschule für Polizei Baden-Württemberg) and Özgür Lütfü Özçep (Universität Hamburg)

entry.title: AgenticOS @ NeurIPS 2026: Co-designing Systems and ML Foundations of an OS Layer for Agentic AI
entry.content:
Defines the abstractions, memory hierarchies, scheduling policies, and governance mechanisms needed for a shared operating-system layer supporting large-scale agentic AI deployments.

  • Type: workshop
  • Dates: December 12, 2026
  • Location: Sydney, Australia
  • Organizer: NeurIPS 2026

entry.title: Agents in the Wild Workshop (3rd edition) — NeurIPS 2026
entry.content:
How intelligent agents can reason, act, and adapt safely and securely when operating autonomously in open-ended real-world environments, covering safety, security, multi-agent coordination, and governance.

  • Type: workshop
  • Dates: December 11 or 12, 2026
  • Location: Sydney, Australia (NeurIPS 2026)
  • Organizer: NeurIPS 2026 (workshop organizers affiliated with UC Santa Cruz & Scale AI)

entry.title: CCS 2026: The 2026 Conference on Complex Systems
entry.content:
Covers theory and applications of complex systems, including networks, self-organization, and collective dynamics.

  • Type: conference
  • Dates: October 12-16, 2026 (main conference)
  • Location: Binghamton, NY, USA
  • Organizer: Complex Systems Society

entry.title: COINE 2026: International Workshop on Coordination, Organizations, Institutions, Norms and Ethics for Governance of Multi-Agent Systems
entry.content:
Covers social coordination, organizational theory, normative multi-agent systems, electronic institutions, and norm/ethics-aware agents for governing open multi-agent systems.

  • Type: workshop
  • Dates: Paper submission: February 23, 2026 (extended); Workshop: May 25, 2026
  • Location: Paphos, Cyprus
  • Organizer: Co-located with AAMAS 2026 (International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems)

entry.title: COINE 2026: International Workshop on Coordination, Organizations, Institutions, Norms and Ethics for Governance of Multi-Agent Systems
entry.content:
Covers social coordination, organizational theory, normative multi-agent systems, and ethics/policy-aware agents for governing open multi-agent systems.

  • Type: workshop
  • Dates: Workshop: May 25th, 2026
  • Location: Paphos (co-located with AAMAS 2026)
  • Organizer: AAMAS 2026 (co-located workshop); COIN/COINE workshop series

entry.title: CompleNet 2026 (17th Annual Conference on Complex Networks)
entry.content:
Covers structure and dynamics of biological, technological, informational, and social networks, drawing on sociology, biology, physics, and computer science.

  • Type: conference
  • Dates: May 4-8, 2026
  • Location: Zaragoza, Spain
  • Organizer: Complex Systems Society (CompleNet conference series)

entry.title: Complex Networks and their Applications 2026 (CNA 2026)
entry.content:
Covers theoretical and applied research on complex networks across disciplines such as physics, biology, and computer science.

  • Type: conference
  • Organizer: International Conference on Complex Networks and their Applications (conference series)

entry.title: Conference on Financial Stability and Macroprudential Policy 2026 – Call for papers
entry.content:
An academic–central bank conference on financial stability and macroprudential policy, with 2026 focus areas including regulatory complexity, banking sector competitiveness, and the role of AI in banking and finance.

  • Type: cfp
  • Dates: Wednesday, 2 and Thursday, 3 December 2026
  • Location: Frankfurt am Main, Germany
  • Organizer: European Central Bank (ECB)

entry.title: Critical Phenomena in Networks 2 (CPIN2) — NetSci 2026 Satellite
entry.content:
An interdisciplinary satellite symposium studying criticality and phase-transition-like phenomena in adaptive, real-world networked systems.

  • Type: workshop
  • Dates: June 1, 2026
  • Location: Boston, MA, USA
  • Organizer: GESIS – Leibniz Institute for the Social Sciences (satellite of NetSci 2026)

entry.title: EconML@NeurIPS26
entry.content:
A workshop bridging micro-scale mechanism design and market-level economic analysis to map the economic consequences of machine learning's growing capabilities and propose interventions for long-term sustainability.

  • Type: workshop
  • Dates: Submission Deadline: August 29, 2026 (AoE); Workshop: December 12 or 13, 2026
  • Location: Atlanta
  • Organizer: NeurIPS 2026 (Neural Information Processing Systems) workshop

entry.title: GSO-2026: Twelfth International Conference on Guided Self-Organization
entry.content:
A conference on information processing in complex self-organizing systems, spanning swarm intelligence, agent-based modeling, and self-organizing cyber-physical systems.

  • Type: conference
  • Dates: October 14-15, 2026
  • Location: Binghamton, NY, USA (co-located with CCS 2026)
  • Organizer: The International Association for Guided Self-Organization (TIA-GSO) and SUNY Binghamton

entry.title: Games, Agents and Incentives Workshop (GAIW 2026)
entry.content:
A workshop on game theory, social choice, mechanism design, and agent-mediated e-commerce aspects of AI systems, spanning topics such as algorithmic mechanism design, auctions, matching markets, computational advertising, and economic aspects of distributed and network computing.

  • Type: workshop
  • Dates: Submission Deadline: Feb 4, 2026 (extended to Feb 11, 2026); AAMAS Conference: May 25–29, 2026; GAIW Workshop: May 26, 2026
  • Location: Paphos, Cyprus
  • Organizer: Co-located with AAMAS 2026 (International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems); 8th iteration of the confederated GAIW workshop series

entry.title: IAB — Interpreting Agent Behavior (NeurIPS 2026 Workshop)
entry.content:
Applies qualitative and trace-analysis methods from the social sciences to agent runtime data to build an interpretive science of agent behavior.

  • Type: workshop
  • Organizer: NeurIPS 2026

entry.title: IWFSAS 2026 – International Workshop on Financial System Architecture & Stability
entry.content:
Examines financial system architecture, stability, and central banking issues under the theme "Fragmentation, Systemic Risk, and the Future of Central Banking."

  • Type: cfp
  • Dates: 09-10 October 2026
  • Location: London
  • Organizer: Bayes Business School, in collaboration with the Euro-Mediterranean Economists Association (EMEA) and the Gustavson School of Business, University of Victoria

entry.title: Joint Bank of Greece / ECB Workshop – Call for papers
entry.content:
Covers unintended consequences of macroprudential policy, including distributional effects and changes in financial intermediation, as an annual workshop.

  • Type: cfp
  • Dates: Thursday, 15 October 2026
  • Organizer: European Central Bank Macroprudential Policy Group (MPPG) and Bank of Greece

entry.title: LSAIR 2026 — Large-Scale AI Risks: Ethics, Safety, and Governance
entry.content:
Addresses risks, ethics, and governance of transformative and agentic AI systems at scale.

  • Type: conference
  • Dates: June 23–24, 2026
  • Location: Leuven, Belgium
  • Organizer: International Conference on Large-Scale AI Risks (2nd edition)

entry.title: MASO 2026: 1st International Workshop on Multi-Agent and Agentic Systems in Organizations
entry.content:
MASO 2026 addresses the socio-technical, operational, and governance challenges of deploying multi-agent and agentic AI systems within private enterprise and public-sector organizations.

  • Type: workshop
  • Dates: Submission deadline: October 10, 2026; Workshop Date: December 14, 2026
  • Location: Kumamoto, Japan
  • Organizer: Organized by Rachele Carli (Umeå University) and Igor Tchappi (University of Luxembourg)

entry.title: Managing Agents that Manage Agents: Workshop on Responsible Use of Meta-Agents
entry.content:
The workshop examines the design, training, evaluation, deployment, and oversight lifecycle of meta-agents that coordinate or manage swarms of subordinate AI agents and, in some cases, humans.

  • Type: workshop
  • Dates: December 11-12, 2026
  • Location: Sydney, Australia
  • Organizer: NeurIPS 2026 (co-located workshop)

entry.title: NERCCS 2026: Ninth Northeast Regional Conference on Complex Systems
entry.content:
A regional conference on complex systems covering nonlinear dynamics, network structure and dynamics, game/decision theory, self-organization, and socio-economic applications.

  • Type: conference
  • Dates: March 11-13, 2026
  • Location: University of Rochester, Rochester, NY, USA
  • Organizer: University of Rochester

entry.title: NetSci 2026 (International School and Conference on Network Science)
entry.content:
The conference of the Network Science Society covering how networks shape social, informational, epidemic, ecological, neuroscientific, and AI-driven systems.

  • Type: conference
  • Dates: June 1-5, 2026
  • Location: Boston, MA, USA
  • Organizer: Network Science Society / Northeastern University Network Science Institute

entry.title: Post-AGI Civilizational Equilibria (Berkeley 2026)
entry.content:
The workshop examines what stable, human-compatible civilizational equilibria might look like after AGI and what institutional preparations are needed now, using perspectives from machine learning, economics, political science, and sociology.

  • Type: workshop
  • Dates: May 23-24th, 2026
  • Location: Berkeley, CA, United States (Lighthaven)
  • Organizer: Post-AGI workshop organizing team (workshop series previously co-located with ICML 2025)

entry.title: School on The Next Era of Network Science: Nonlinear Dynamics, Multiscale Interactions and Beyond
entry.content:
Covers multilayer network structures, synchronization, nonlinear dynamics, and applications in neuroscience, epidemics, mobility, and social systems.

  • Type: workshop
  • Dates: March 2-6, 2026
  • Location: IFT-UNESP, São Paulo, Brazil
  • Organizer: ICTP-SAIFR (International Centre for Theoretical Physics – South American Institute for Fundamental Research)

entry.title: TAS 2026: Trustworthy Agentic Systems
entry.content:
The symposium covers engineering, measurement, and governance of trustworthy, accountable agentic AI systems across their full lifecycle, including auditing, standards alignment, and human oversight.

  • Type: conference
  • Dates: November 5–7, 2026
  • Location: Westin Arlington, Arlington, Virginia, USA
  • Organizer: AAAI 2026 Fall Symposium Series

entry.title: The 2nd Workshop on Advances in Financial AI
entry.content:
Covers agentic and multi-agent systems in finance, including autonomous trading bots, robo-advisors, and adaptive risk-management agents, their coordination effects on market dynamics and systemic stability, and responsible and trustworthy financial AI.

  • Type: workshop
  • Organizer: Workshop organizing committee (second edition of an established workshop series, per OpenReview listing)
